cli.braincrawl.text:
`braincrawl [options]`

braincrawl research graph CLI

```yaml
options:
  --json: global — Output as JSON (default)
  --text: global — Output as compact text (one result per line)
  --limit <LIMIT>: global — Maximum number of results to return
  --all: global — Return all results, ignoring limit
  --fields <FIELDS>: global — Comma-separated list of fields to include in output
  --full: global — Return full record (all fields)
  --skip-push: global — Do not push results to the local store
  --abstract: global — Include reconstructed abstract text (bulky; off by default)
  --emission: global — Emit the store-ready emission frame instead of the display envelope
```

subcommands: arxiv, catalog, collection, crossref, library, migrate-store, openalex, opencitations, rename, semanticscholar, web

cli.braincrawl.arxiv.text:
`braincrawl arxiv`

Query the arXiv preprint API

subcommands: get, search

cli.braincrawl.arxiv.get.text:
`braincrawl arxiv get <id>`

Fetch a single arXiv work by ID (e.g. arxiv:2301.07041 or 2301.07041)

```yaml
positionals:
  id: required — arXiv ID (arxiv:…, bare numeric, old-style hep-th/…, or full URL)
```

cli.braincrawl.arxiv.search.text:
`braincrawl arxiv search <query>`

Search arXiv by query string

```yaml
positionals:
  query: required — Search query; use field operators (ti:/au:/cat:) or plain text (wrapped as all:…)
```

cli.braincrawl.catalog.text:
`braincrawl catalog`

Work metadata, aliases, and citation edges (Layer 2)

subcommands: get, have, neighborhood, put, stats

cli.braincrawl.catalog.get.text:
`braincrawl catalog get <id>`

Retrieve a work by alias (ns:value)

```yaml
positionals:
  id: required
```

cli.braincrawl.catalog.have.text:
`braincrawl catalog have [ids]`

Check which of the given aliases (ns:value) are present in the store

```yaml
positionals:
  ids:
```

cli.braincrawl.catalog.neighborhood.text:
`braincrawl catalog neighborhood [seeds] [options]`

Bounded neighborhood traversal from one or more seed ids

```yaml
positionals:
  seeds: Seed ids in ns:value form (e.g. openalex:W2031938753 doi:10.x/y)
options:
  --dir <DIR>: default forward — Traversal direction: forward (src→dst) or backward (dst→src)
  --depth <DEPTH>: default 1 — Max BFS depth from the seeds
  --max-nodes <MAX_NODES>: default 200 — Max nodes in the returned subgraph
```

cli.braincrawl.catalog.put.text:
`braincrawl catalog put [file]`

Write works and edges from an emission frame (stdin or a file) to the catalog

```yaml
positionals:
  file: Read the emission from this file instead of stdin
```

cli.braincrawl.catalog.stats.text:
`braincrawl catalog stats`

Show aggregate statistics about the metadata network

cli.braincrawl.collection.text:
`braincrawl collection`

Research Documents — the consolidated store (Layer 3)

subcommands: assign-ids, check, import, index, list, new, path, pull, push, reading-list, rm

cli.braincrawl.collection.assign-ids.text:
`braincrawl collection assign-ids [options]`

Assign `^r-…` anchors for every `##` heading that lacks one

```yaml
options:
  --dry-run: Report what would be assigned; write nothing
```

cli.braincrawl.collection.check.text:
`braincrawl collection check [doc] [options]`

Lint a doc (or --all) against the required frontmatter; advisory, never fails

```yaml
positionals:
  doc: Doc slug (omit with --all)
options:
  --all: Check every doc in the store
```

cli.braincrawl.collection.import.text:
`braincrawl collection import <file> [options]`

Adopt an existing markdown file into the store, normalizing its frontmatter

```yaml
positionals:
  file: required — Path to the existing .md / .l3.md file
options:
  --doc <DOC>: Doc slug override (default: existing `doc`/`domain` frontmatter, else filename stem)
  --mv: Remove the source file after a successful import
```

cli.braincrawl.collection.index.text:
`braincrawl collection index`

Regenerate INDEX.md from every doc's frontmatter

cli.braincrawl.collection.list.text:
`braincrawl collection list`

List all L3 docs in the store

cli.braincrawl.collection.new.text:
`braincrawl collection new <doc> [options]`

Create a new L3 doc in the store; prints its absolute path to stdout

```yaml
positionals:
  doc: required — Doc slug (kebab-case) — the primary key and filename stem
options:
  --title <TITLE>: Human title for the H1 heading (defaults to the doc slug)
  --force: Overwrite if a doc with this slug already exists
```

cli.braincrawl.collection.path.text:
`braincrawl collection path <doc>`

Print the absolute path of an existing L3 doc to stdout

```yaml
positionals:
  doc: required — Doc slug
```

cli.braincrawl.collection.pull.text:
`braincrawl collection pull [doc] [options]`

Pull doc(s) from the worker's consolidated L3 store into the local repo

```yaml
positionals:
  doc: Doc slug (omit to pull every pull-candidate doc)
options:
  --dry-run: Print the plan without transferring or touching sync state
```

cli.braincrawl.collection.push.text:
`braincrawl collection push [doc] [options]`

Push local doc(s) to the worker's consolidated L3 store

```yaml
positionals:
  doc: Doc slug (omit to push every push-candidate doc)
options:
  --dry-run: Print the plan without transferring or touching sync state
  --force: Bypass the worker's warning bounce (400) on push
```

cli.braincrawl.collection.reading-list.text:
`braincrawl collection reading-list`

List every node with a `reading` property and its catalog work, grouped by role

cli.braincrawl.collection.rm.text:
`braincrawl collection rm <doc>`

Delete a doc from the store and reindex

```yaml
positionals:
  doc: required — Doc slug
```

cli.braincrawl.crossref.text:
`braincrawl crossref`

Backfill backward references from Crossref's deposited reference list

subcommands: refs

cli.braincrawl.crossref.refs.text:
`braincrawl crossref refs <id>`

List works the given work references (via Crossref deposited reference list)

```yaml
positionals:

```

cli.braincrawl.library.text:
`braincrawl library`

Artifact bytes held against a work (Layer 1)

subcommands: chunk, extract-text, fetch, get, list, put

cli.braincrawl.library.chunk.text:
`braincrawl library chunk [id] [options]`

Partition a work's stored fulltext into a citation-carrying chunks artifact

```yaml
positionals:
  id: Work id in ns:value form (stored fulltext → writes the chunks artifact)
options:
  --file <FILE>: External PDF file — PIPE-ONLY: emits JSON to stdout, never stored
  --role <ROLE>: default chunks — Output artifact role slug
  --max-tokens <MAX_TOKENS>: default 512
  --overlap <OVERLAP>: default 64
  --stdout: Stream JSON to stdout instead of storing
  --allow-partial: Chunk faithful pages and skip image-only ones instead of refusing
  --force: Re-chunk even if a chunks artifact already exists
```

cli.braincrawl.library.extract-text.text:
`braincrawl library extract-text <id> [options]`

Extract text from a work's stored fulltext PDF artifact

```yaml
positionals:
  id: required — Work id in ns:value form (e.g. openalex:W2304167012)
options:
  --role <ROLE>: default text — Artifact role slug to store the extracted text at
  --force: Re-extract even if the role already holds an artifact
  --stdout: Emit text to stdout instead of storing
```

cli.braincrawl.library.fetch.text:
`braincrawl library fetch <id> [options]`

Acquire a work's fulltext artifact from the open web into the store

```yaml
positionals:
  id: required — Work id in ns:value form (e.g. openalex:W2165758805 or doi:10.x/y)
options:
  --from <FROM>: default auto — Where to resolve the artifact URL from (auto|openalex|unpaywall)
  --force: Re-fetch even if a fulltext artifact already exists
  --require-pdf: Only accept a PDF artifact (reject HTML or other content types)
  --stdout: Emit bytes to stdout instead of storing
  -o, --output <OUTPUT>: Write bytes to this path instead of storing
```

cli.braincrawl.library.get.text:
`braincrawl library get <id> [options]`

Read a stored artifact's bytes to stdout

```yaml
positionals:
  id: required — Work id in ns:value form (e.g. openalex:W2304167012)
options:
  -o, --output <OUTPUT>: Write bytes to this path instead of stdout
  --role <ROLE>: default fulltext — Artifact role slug (e.g. fulltext, abstract, map)
```

cli.braincrawl.library.list.text:
`braincrawl library list <id> [options]`

List every artifact a work holds — role, version, size, mime, provenance

```yaml
positionals:
  id: required — Work id in ns:value form (e.g. openalex:W2304167012)
options:
  --role <ROLE>: Restrict to a single artifact role
  --all-versions: Include superseded versions, not just the current one per role
```

cli.braincrawl.library.put.text:
`braincrawl library put <id> [file] [options]`

Store bytes from stdin or a file as an artifact of the given role

```yaml
positionals:
  id: required — Work id in ns:value form (e.g. openalex:W2304167012)
  file: Read bytes from this file instead of stdin
options:
  --mime <MIME>: Content mime type (default: sniff %PDF, else application/octet-stream)
  --source <SOURCE>: Optional source label recorded with the artifact
  --source-url <SOURCE_URL>: Optional source URL recorded with the artifact
  --role <ROLE>: default fulltext — Artifact role slug (e.g. fulltext, abstract, map)
```

cli.braincrawl.migrate-store.text:
`braincrawl migrate-store [options]`

Replay the local SQLite + blob corpus into a remote store over its HTTP API

```yaml
options:
  --db <DB>: Path to the local SQLite database (default: $HOME/.local/share/braincrawl/braincrawl.db)
  --blobs <BLOBS>: Path to the local blob root directory (default: $HOME/.local/share/braincrawl/blobs)
  --dry-run: Print the plan counts without pushing any work, edge, or artifact
```

cli.braincrawl.openalex.text:
`braincrawl openalex`

Query the OpenAlex scholarly-data API

subcommands: autocomplete, cited-by, find, get, refs, search

cli.braincrawl.openalex.autocomplete.text:
`braincrawl openalex autocomplete <entity> <q>`

Autocomplete entity names by prefix

```yaml
positionals:
  entity: required — Entity type (works, authors, sources, institutions, topics, publishers, funders)
  q: required — Prefix query string
```

cli.braincrawl.openalex.cited-by.text:
`braincrawl openalex cited-by <id>`

List works that cite the given work

```yaml
positionals:
  id: required — OpenAlex work ID (W…) or external ID (doi:…)
```

cli.braincrawl.openalex.find.text:
`braincrawl openalex find <entity> [filters]`

Filter an entity collection by key:value expressions

```yaml
positionals:
  entity: required — Entity type (works, authors, sources, institutions, topics, keywords, publishers, funders)
  filters: Filter expressions in `key:value` form (e.g. `publication_year:2020` `is_oa:true`)
```

cli.braincrawl.openalex.get.text:
`braincrawl openalex get <id>`

Fetch a single entity by ID (entity type inferred from ID prefix)

```yaml
positionals:
  id: required — OpenAlex ID (W…/A…/S…/I…/T…/P…/F…/C…) or external ID (doi:…/orcid:…/issn:…/ror:…)
```

cli.braincrawl.openalex.refs.text:
`braincrawl openalex refs <id>`

List works referenced by the given work

```yaml
positionals:
  id: required — OpenAlex work ID (W…) or external ID (doi:…)
```

cli.braincrawl.openalex.search.text:
`braincrawl openalex search <entity> <query>`

Full-text search over an entity collection

```yaml
positionals:
  entity: required — Entity type (works, authors, sources, institutions, topics, keywords, publishers, funders)
  query: required — Search query string
```

subcommands: refs

cli.braincrawl.opencitations.refs.text:
`braincrawl opencitations refs <id>`

List works the given work references (via OpenCitations COCI index)

```yaml
positionals:

```

cli.braincrawl.rename.text:
`braincrawl rename <file> [options]`

Rename a work file to its canonical bibliographic filename

```yaml
positionals:
  file: required — Path to the file to rename (extension is preserved)
options:
  --author <AUTHOR>: required — First author's surname (may contain spaces/particles, e.g. "Van De Mieroop")
  --et-al: The work has more than one author (renders the EtAl marker)
  --year <YEAR>: required — Publication year
  --title <TITLE>: required — Work title (slugified for the filename)
  --dry-run: Print the proposed new path; do not rename
```

cli.braincrawl.semanticscholar.text:
`braincrawl semanticscholar`

cli.braincrawl.semanticscholar.cited-by.text:
`braincrawl semanticscholar cited-by <id>`

List papers that cite the given paper

```yaml
positionals:
  id: required — Paper ID (doi:…/arxiv:…/corpusid:…/s2:…/40-char hex)
```

cli.braincrawl.semanticscholar.get.text:
`braincrawl semanticscholar get <id>`

Fetch a single paper or author by ID (entity type inferred from ID prefix)

```yaml
positionals:
  id: required — Semantic Scholar ID (doi:…/arxiv:…/corpusid:…/s2:…/s2author:…/40-char hex)
```

cli.braincrawl.semanticscholar.refs.text:
`braincrawl semanticscholar refs <id>`

List papers referenced by the given paper

```yaml
positionals:
  id: required — Paper ID (doi:…/arxiv:…/corpusid:…/s2:…/40-char hex)
```

cli.braincrawl.semanticscholar.search.text:
`braincrawl semanticscholar search <entity> <query>`

Full-text search over papers or authors

```yaml
positionals:
  entity: required — Entity type (papers, authors)
  query: required — Search query string
```
